title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
description: One of the higher perches at the western end of this region, this small hilltop gives a sufficient overview of the surrounding area.  A steep incline to the east ends at a magnificent waterfall, while the northwest pathway leads to a stunning blue-green lake.  Occasional flashes of sapphire shimmer against the mountain backdrop and periodically compete for attention with the lightning strikes that seem to plague the upper plateau.
